```python
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
iris = pd.read_csv('data/iris.csv')

# Set the style of the visualization
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a pairplot to visualize the relationships between the variables in the dataset
pairplot = sns.pairplot(iris, hue='species', diag_kind='kde', palette='husl')

# Add a title to the pairplot
pairplot.fig.suptitle('Pairplot of Iris Dataset', y=1.02)

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
```
